Journalist.description: A reporter, editor or photographer at the paper, staff or freelance. A first name alone is not an identity.

Story.description: One piece in the news list, known by its slug, whoever works on it.

StoryRole.description:
Who does what on a story: the writer who files it, the editor who checks it, or the photographer who takes its pictures.
Editing a story is not writing it.

Pairing.description: A working tie between two journalists: one is the deputy of the other, or trains the other.

Correction.description: A fix to a published story. flagged_by spotted the error, fixed_by wrote the fix, signed_off_by approved it.

questions.q: Who is the editor of Harbour Strike?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Story)-[:editor]->(n1:Journalist) WHERE n0.slug = 'Harbour Strike' RETURN n1.byline AS byline

questions.q: Who is the photographer for Night Market Fire?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Story)-[:photographer]->(n1:Journalist) WHERE n0.slug = 'Night Market Fire' RETURN n1.byline AS byline

questions.q: Who is the writer on Rail Fare Probe?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Story)-[:writer]->(n1:Journalist) WHERE n0.slug = 'Rail Fare Probe' RETURN n1.byline AS byline

questions.speaker: bashir
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Journalist)-[:edited]->(n1:Story) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.slug AS slug

questions.q: Which stories has Amara Nwosu authored?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Journalist)-[:authored]->(n1:Story) WHERE n0.byline = 'Amara Nwosu' RETURN n1.slug AS slug

questions.speaker: amara_l
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Journalist)-[:trainer]->(n1:Journalist) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.byline AS byline

questions.q: Who is the deputy for Bashir Haddad?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Journalist)-[:deputy]->(n1:Journalist) WHERE n0.byline = 'Bashir Haddad' RETURN n1.byline AS byline

questions.q: Who is the trainee of Mirela Popescu?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Journalist)-[:trainee]->(n1:Journalist) WHERE n0.byline = 'Mirela Popescu' RETURN n1.byline AS byline

questions.q: Is there a record of legal review for the Night Market Fire correction?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Story)<-[:story]-(n1:Correction) WHERE n0.slug = 'Night Market Fire' RETURN coalesce(n1.legal_review, false) AS legal_review

questions.q: Did the Flood Barrier correction get a legal review?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Story)<-[:story]-(n1:Correction) WHERE n0.slug = 'Flood Barrier' RETURN n1.legal_review AS legal_review

questions.q: How many words long are the corrections flagged by Rangi Parata?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Journalist)<-[:flagged_by]-(n1:Correction) WHERE n0.byline = 'Rangi Parata' RETURN n1.word_count AS word_count

questions.q: Who fixed the corrections I flagged?
questions.speaker: rangi
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Journalist)<-[:flagged_by]-(n1:Correction)-[:fixed_by]->(n2:Journalist) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n2.byline AS byline

questions.q: What is the status of the correction about the height?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Correction) WHERE n0.wording CONTAINS 'height' RETURN n0.status AS status

questions.q: List each correction with its word count and status.
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Correction) RETURN n0.word_count AS word_count, n0.status AS status
MATCH (n0:Journalist) WHERE n0.byline = 'Mirela Popescu' RETURN n0.email AS email
